# Parameter Foundry

> Jenkins plugin for typed choices, reactive forms, file uploads, governed
> Providers, and reviewed migration from legacy parameter plugins.

Repository: https://github.com/xykong/parameter-foundry-plugin
Plugin short name: parameter-foundry
Current tagged version: 1.27.386
Development: 1.28.999999-SNAPSHOT, Jenkins 2.555.3; build/runtime target: Java 21.
Tagged 1.27.386: Jenkins 2.528.3, Java 17 bytecode. Build with Maven 3.9+.
Status: public source repository; Jenkins community hosting and update-center
publication pending. No GitHub Release assets are currently provided. Build
plugin/target/parameter-foundry.hpi from source. Do not claim plugin-manager
availability or that historical development release notes imply public binaries.

## Public configuration symbols

Parameter definitions: foundryChoice, foundryForm, foundryReference, foundryFile,
foundryBase64File, foundryStashedFile.
Pipeline helpers: withFoundryFileParameter, foundryParameterText.
Providers: foundryStaticProvider, foundryNodeProvider, foundryMappingProvider,
foundryMatrixProvider, foundryManagedConfigProvider, foundryRestProvider,
foundryGitRefProvider, foundryScriptProvider.
Supporting configuration: foundryOption, foundryFormField, foundryFormLayout,
foundryConnectionProfile, foundryProfileHeader, foundryRestQuery, foundryTransform,
foundryMappingCase, foundryScriptCatalogEntry, foundryRawLiteral,
foundryRawFailureChoice. Global/Folder configuration uses parameterFoundry.
These are contextual configuration symbols, not interchangeable Pipeline steps.
Job DSL closures differ from Pipeline named-argument definitions.

## Value and transport rules

- Ordinary single choice: string or null. Ordinary multiple choice: canonical
  sorted list. Form: map or JSON string. Labels do not determine machine identity.
- Multiple-choice environment export can preserve submitted order independently
  of canonical values. Explicit legacy modes can use Core string storage.
- Active Choices single/multiple compatibility preserves source strings and
  independent UI/API defaults. Filtering and dependency-refresh policies are
  explicit. Typed explicit submissions retain their defined membership checks.
- Static Extended Choice compatibility preserves reviewed literal defaults,
  empty options/tokens, duplicate entries and export order. valueTransport:
  core-string requires static multiple extended-choice mode with delimited export.
- List Git Branches mode accepts literal revisions independently of the advisory
  option listing. UI selection and API defaults are separate. cacheTtlSeconds: 0
  retries Git failures on the next request; sortOrder: none has no stable-order
  guarantee across runtimes.
- foundryReference sanitizes literal HTML; it does not execute dynamic scripts.
- foundryParameterText reads current-build saved strings, not overridden env,
  reconstructed lists, defaults, or Provider results. Sensitive/file values are excluded.
- Typed JSON endpoints under each Job's parameter-foundry/api/v1/ are schema,
  resolve, validate, build, providers/health, and import/preview. Binary definitions
  require standard multipart/file transports rather than this JSON API.
- Rebuild delimited scalar strings are split by the configured literal delimiter;
  native array elements retain their boundaries. Current validation still applies.

## Providers and security

- Inline choices or a global/Folder Provider supply options. dependsOn declares
  reactive inputs; snapshots bind supported submissions to definitions/dependencies.
- Connection Profiles control destinations, credential IDs, path/query allowlists,
  timeouts and sizes. Runtime includes caching, fallback policies and request budgets.
- REST mapped and reviewed Active Choices JSON modes are data-only. Whole-response
  REST has a separate restricted credential-free transport, exact literals, finite
  DNS/TLS failure declarations, and separately opted-in same-origin redirect targets.
  TLS validation is never bypassed; status policy alone does not follow redirects.
- Core evaluation does not execute Job-supplied scripts or read arbitrary controller
  paths. The bundled sandbox-groovy engine uses reviewed catalog entries through
  Script Security. Reference HTML is sanitized, not arbitrary executable markup.

## File delivery

- foundryFile: workspace (default), base64, or stash. Dedicated older symbols remain.
- maxUploadBytes: 0 inherits 1 MiB decoded Base64 or 100 MiB workspace/stash;
  positive values override the limit. Infrastructure and environment limits also apply.
- Freestyle places workspace files automatically; Pipeline uses
  withFoundryFileParameter in an allocated workspace. Base64/stash wrapper binds a
  temporary path; workspace mode preserves original-filename environment semantics.
- Rejected/cancelled uploads are cleaned up; retained content follows build lifecycle.
  Rebuild can reuse retained Foundry uploads; mode changes need replacement bytes.
- Legacy file migration requires wrapper/producer/history review. Base64 is unsuitable
  for secrets. Job read permissions govern uploaded-file access.

## Migration and history

- 14 source families: Extended Choice, Active Choices, List Git Branches, Custom
  Checkbox, Editable Choice, Extensible Choice, HTML Parameters, JSON Editor,
  JSON Parameter, Multiselect, REST List, Validating String, File Parameters, Core File.
- CLI: parameter-foundry-migration and parameter-foundry-migration-verify.
  Preview classification/decisions, per-Job atomic apply, rollback, A/B evidence,
  read-only replacement simulation, and retirement reporting have distinct roles.
- Jenkinsfile-declared parameters and multibranch generators need source edits.
  Adapter classification alone is not proof of source or historical workflow parity.
- legacyGitHistoryEnabled and legacyExtendedChoiceHistoryEnabled default false,
  require a full restart, source absence, integrity, and class-ownership acceptance.
- File history remains a development capability: legacyFileHistoryEnabled defaults
  false; legacyFileHistoryMaxBytes defaults 100 MiB. Completed local values/passive
  metadata only; no pending upload, active wrapper, remote-storage or uninstall guarantee.
